room_rent.display: Single Private A.C. Room (up to Deluxe Room)
room_rent.note: Default entitlement is Single Private A.C. Room. Optional add-on (3.4.11) allows downgrade to Twin Sharing for a discount. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room chosen.

icu.note: Policy explicitly states ICU charges shall not be proportionately reduced in all cases.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base policy. Voluntary co-payment (3.4.1) available as optional add-on for premium discount. DME benefit has mandatory 20% co-pay; Dental OPD under Plan B has mandatory 20% co-pay; OPD reimbursement has 10% co-pay.

sub_limits.note: Special Treatments capped at 50% of SI for SI <10L, 100% for SI >=10L. Transportation benefit capped at ₹500/hospitalisation. Maternity (optional) has own sub-limit. No sub-limits on standard inpatient, day care, domiciliary.

deductible.note: Voluntary Aggregate Deductible (3.4.13) available as optional add-on: ₹10,000 / ₹25,000 / ₹50,000 / ₹1,00,000.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses (Excl03). COVID-19 has a 15-day waiting period.

ped_waiting.note: Default PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional add-on (3.4.9) allows reduction to 24 or 12 months for additional premium.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Default specific disease waiting period is 24 months (Excl02). Optional add-on (3.4.10) reduces it to 12 months.

maternity.note: Maternity excluded by default (Excl18). Available as paid add-on (3.4.4.1) only for 3-year policies, female members 18-45 yrs. Limits: ₹1L for SI 5L; ₹1L or ₹2L for SI >=10L. Max 2 deliveries/lifetime. Waiting period 12 or 24 months as opted.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording. A 'Stay Healthy Discount' of up to 10% on renewal premium is available for submitting annual health check-up results, but this is a premium discount, not a SI increase.

restoration.note: Inbuilt Restore Benefit (3.1.11): restores 100% of SI once per policy year for unrelated illness/injury only. Optional Unlimited Restore (3.4.2.2) upgrades to unlimited restorations; for SI >=10L covers related illness too.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient AYUSH hospital)

ambulance.display: Covered (within SI, no separate cap stated)
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered within Sum Insured under Basic Benefit 3.1.9, including intercity (beyond 100km). Air Ambulance available as optional add-on (3.4.3.2).

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern/special treatments listed under 3.1.2 including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy etc. Capped at 50% of SI for SI <10L; 100% of SI for SI >=10L.

consumables.note: Consumables excluded by default (Annexure A List I). Available as paid add-on under Limitless Cover (3.4.2.1).

global_cover.note: International treatment excluded by default. MoreGlobal (3.2.3) available as optional More Options Benefit; covers emergency and planned overseas treatment up to SI (planned capped at ₹50L); available up to 45 cumulative days/year. USD 100 deductible per OPD claim.

notable_exclusions: Peritoneal dialysis, hormone replacement therapy, growth hormone therapy, external congenital anomaly, hazardous activity injuries (professional), spinal manipulation, self-injury/suicide, war/nuclear/bio/chemical attack
optional_riders: Unlimited Restore, Consumables Cover, Super Charger (SI top-up), Air Ambulance, Maternity+Newborn, OPD (Plan A/B), Double Cover, MoreGlobal, MoreCover, Home Care, DME/Small Equipment, Voluntary Deductible, PED waiting period reduction
